protocol.claim_boundary: external frozen decoder coordinate tracking on fresh matched-target order states; it creates pass/fail strata for a later descriptive residual analysis and does not test Demian adaptation, self-decoding, routing, learning, or channel causality
protocol.controls: Identity, scalar-scale, proper-orthogonal tracking; analytic latest-cue; conditional train-label shuffle.
protocol.decision_rule: A heldout cell is a strict transport pass only when proper-orthogonal true-label R2 exceeds both analytic latest-cue and conditional-shuffle R2. Report all cells; no all-cell portability claim follows unless all 12 heldout cells pass at a delay. The resulting strata are only descriptive inputs to the separately preregistered residual analysis.
protocol.fitting_rule: Fit cue6 readout, standardization and temporal tracker only on base-order train32. Apply unchanged objects to paired base-order eval32 and heldout-order eval32. Heldout target_train is not used for any fit.
